question: Find the display names of users who own posts with above-average favorite counts and have earned both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN badges AS b1 ON u."XCL_052" = b1."XCL_002" AND b1."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
INNER JOIN badges AS b2 ON u."XCL_052" = b2."XCL_002" AND b2."XCL_003" = 'Supporter'
WHERE p."XCL_039" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_039") FROM posts)
